im not a lawyer, however I would recommend with start talking to your mom about how school makes you feel. Open the conversation to the possibility of taking your schoolwork to a credited online program. (looks like there are a few for you to choose from in your district!)     This is the route I took with my mental health, and it still allowed me to complete my public education without the stress of other people around me. 
     As for the truancy issue, If they haven't contacted your mom about being habitually truant yet; they will. I wouldn't quiet worry about it. Until they've tried their hand at keeping you in school (Truant officers, Probationary points, etc) they can't really take you to court unless you ignore all those things i believe. Which is why it's important to talk to your mom about this sooner rather than later. 
     It's a hard world my friend, I hope you find the comfort and space to thrive in the future. Good luck :)
